about: The figures the time case (src/timecase.mjs, claims-timecase.json) takes from outside the estate's basis, each with its source. Read 2026-11-04 from the primary sources named.

wordsPerMinute.what: Average typing speed of the participants (SD 20.2), transcribing given sentences on their own keyboards in an online typing test
wordsPerMinute.cite: Dhakal, Feit, Kristensson and Oulasvirta, Observations on Typing from 136 Million Keystrokes, CHI 2018 (Words per minute, Results)

charsPerWord.what: The word the speed is counted in: any five characters, the standard definition in text-entry research, as the same paper states it
charsPerWord.cite: Dhakal, Feit, Kristensson and Oulasvirta, CHI 2018 (Method, computed measures)

participants.what: The participants in the final dataset the average speed is taken over (136,857,600 keystrokes)
participants.cite: Dhakal, Feit, Kristensson and Oulasvirta, CHI 2018 (Results)

leaveWeeks.what: Statutory paid holiday: almost all workers in the UK are legally entitled to 5.6 weeks' paid holiday a year

weeksInYear.what: The weeks in a year the statutory holiday is set against: a worker's total working weeks in a year is 46.4 (52 weeks in a year minus 5.6 weeks of leave)
